components.name: Exact collision-polynomial inflation under candidate-domain enlargement
components.project_addition: Lift the false-collision phenomenon exposed by P023/P017 back into the existing P011 collision-polynomial owner. For realized labeled images A_i contained in candidate supersets C_i, write m_C(y)=m_A(y)+delta(y). Then K_C-K_A=sum_y (1+t)^{m_A(y)}((1+t)^{delta(y)}-1), so every collision coefficient increases by an explicit nonnegative Vandermonde sum; in particular Delta J_2=sum_y[m_A(y)delta(y)+binom(delta(y),2)]. The P017 k=14 root-9 candidate overlap has exact false pair-collision cost one. Binomial/Vandermonde combinatorics is prior art; historical novelty of this project-specific theorem-lifting use remains unverified.
